evidence_correction: A prior record revision stated an expected-fail result from a mixed working tree without a committed source identity. That result is withdrawn. Only command results bound to the tested implementation are verification facts.
claim_boundary: local hermetic ExecutionRecord persistence-contract evidence only; no Verification Agent behavior-layer capability, Android/OEM, production-outcome, sudden-host-loss durability, formal-run, or quality-threshold claim

historical_context.relationship: #171 exposed this separate Behavior-Layer Defect during review; this repair does not rewrite its historical audit or frozen evidence.

quality_contract.name: fail-closed accountability
quality_contract.pre_publication: A storage error before os.replace preserves the in-progress ExecutionRecord and raises ExecutionRecordStorageError.
quality_contract.post_publication: A directory fsync or temporary-path cleanup error after os.replace returns the published terminal record and logs local uncertainty rather than reporting an uncommitted storage failure.

post_publication_regression_contract.command: /usr/bin/time -p uv run --extra dev python -W error -m pytest -o addopts='' -q -rs tests/runner/test_execution_record.py

focused_runner_regression.command: /usr/bin/time -p uv run --extra dev python -m pytest -o addopts='' -q -rs tests/runner/test_execution_record.py tests/runner/test_cli.py tests/runner/test_execution_identity.py

default_hermetic_suite.command: /usr/bin/time -p uv run --extra dev python -m pytest -o addopts='' -q -rs
default_hermetic_suite.skip_reason: repository-external fixture tests require explicit admission

compile.command: uv run --extra dev python -m compileall -q src

known_gaps: A directory fsync error after terminal publication remains a local durability uncertainty; this repair does not prove survival across sudden host or filesystem loss.
A post-publication temporary-path cleanup error is logged rather than misreported as an uncommitted terminal record; this repair does not claim recovery from arbitrary filesystem corruption.
The checks use temporary local files and controlled persistence seams; they do not perform Android, device, backend, model, oracle-service, or formal-run actions.
The repository-external historical fixture remains skipped by default; frozen M8, M9, and M9-R evidence was neither replayed nor changed.
